title: VocabularyLabels
description: The concept block each phrase of the step's phrase list belongs to (SW17). Code extracted the phrases; this step only sorts them. Every given phrase must appear exactly once and no other phrase may appear: the step may not add, split, reword or drop a phrase, and an output that does is rejected rather than repaired.

labels.description: One entry per phrase in vocabulary_target.phrases, in any order. No rationale field: the step makes one classification and free text would not be checked.

phrase.description: Copied exactly from the given phrase list.
